about_the_game:
Trigwa is a problem solving game with a narrative.

You, as The Stranger, have heeded the call for help from a faraway land, shunned by most and known for its strange ways and obsession with its once greater past.

Solve puzzles in a vast underground tomb spanning several floors and unravel the history of the land, room by room, floor by floor.

How to play:

The game will run using GBCbag 2.

Requires Windows 10/11. For Linux and macOS users, find the file game.gb in the folder "Game" and run it separately in an emulator (Sameboy, bgb or Mesen recommended).

GBCbag 2 Settings

Controls:

You can set up your preferred controls in Settings -> Controls and Video -> Input, but there are 4 pre-configured control schemes:

  • WASD + the Comma key (,) + the Period key (.) + Space bar and Left Ctrl

  • Arrow keys + C + X + Space bar + Left Ctrl

  • PS4 controller using the Dpad + X + Square + R1 + L1

  • Xbox controller using the Dpad + A + B + Start + Back

Screen:

Fullscreen can be toggled by pressing F11.

A few video filters are available in Settings -> Video Filter, and a larger choice of various filters can be set in Settings -> Controls and Video -> Video, and then by checking Override video filter.

Recommended settings are: Fullscreen, LCD Grid and Use bilinear interpolation, and under Controls and Video -> Video (enabled by default); Enable GBC LCD color emulation and Enable LCD frame blending.
